newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds firm but illiquid, eye Fed.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds firm but illiquid, eye Fed.

text.p: 1755 GMT - Bonds end firmer in line with the European trend but volumes thin. Likely to stay cautious ahead of U.S. Federal Reserve meeting Tuesday which could decide on rate rise.
*Feb 07 cash 97.95 vs 97.70. Yld 6.92 vs 6.95 Thurs close
*Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -22 bps vs -25 bps
